video_title: I got married! Behind the scenes look at the big day

quotes.speaker: Tyrese Haliburton
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyrese Haliburton on the unique experience of blending family and teammates
quotes.excerpt: The coolest part about a wedding is every time you go hang out with your girl's family
quotes.quote: The coolest part about a wedding is every time you go hang out with your girl's family and you're like, 'Dang, I like him, he's cool,' combined with your people. Everyone together in one. The first time that everybody in her family, her friends, are all combined with all mine as well. Seeing my world collide with people from home, the teammates, with coaches, all that stuff, that'll be cool.

quotes.speaker: Tyrese Haliburton
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyrese Haliburton and Mike Jones discuss wedding day nerves
quotes.excerpt: You got the easy part, all you got to do is walk.

text_blocks.speaker: Tyrese Haliburton
text_blocks.text: Are you nervous yet? I'm a little nervous. I have some butterflies.

text_blocks.speaker: Mike Jones
text_blocks.text: No, don't need, no need. You got the easy part, all you got to do is walk.

text_blocks.speaker: Tyrese Haliburton
text_blocks.text: That's literally all you do. I got to give a speech, though. I got to do my vows.

quotes.speaker: John Haliburton
quotes.summary_phrase: John Haliburton on watching his son Tyrese get married
quotes.excerpt: Everybody see him as a man, and I still see him as my baby.
quotes.quote: Everybody see him as a man, and I still see him as my baby. It's hard to see it, that just before, a little bit of kid to be a man. God help bless them so well there. He's finding the person of his heart. Be happy, he enjoy what he's doing, and I'm just happy to be here.
